paper_title: ToolFactory Automating Tool Generation by Leveraging LLM to Understand   REST API Documentations
caption: Training loss of APILLAMA. We applied moving average of window size 5 to smooth the training curve. Validation result is produced in every 20 steps.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the training and evaluation loss per batch for APILLAMA. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", has a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 2.7, with tick labels at regular intervals of 0.5. The x-axis, labeled "Step", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140, with tick labels at regular intervals of 20. There are two lines in the plot: one in blue, representing "Smoothed Training Loss per Batch", which starts at approximately 2.7 and ends at around 0.3, with fluctuations in between; and one in orange, representing "Validation Loss", which starts at around 1.7 and ends at approximately 0.3, initially decreasing steeply before stabilizing. The blue line has no visible markers and a solid line style, while the orange line also has a solid line style. The blue line shows an initial sharp decline from 2.7 to 1.0 across steps 0-10, followed by fluctuations, and then a more gradual decline to 0.3 across steps 20-140. The orange line decreases from 1.7 to 0.3 across steps 20-140.
